flags.title: Observed redirect is a fallback route, not a canonical resolution
flags.detail: All five final URLs carried lv=shuf and plpRedirect=mhFallback. That is Amazon's shuffle/listing-page fallback, i.e. the requested identifier did not resolve to a listing. The mapping is stable across 2026-11-17 and 2026-11-20, so 'observed' is a trustworthy record of where the link goes — but it is NOT evidence of what the supplier intended. Intended fields stay blank for this reason.
flags.action: Get the ten-character ASIN or full /dp/ URL from the link supplier (Q-02). Until then never describe the observed product as 'the product you gave us'.

flags.title: Emeril 26QT listing: 'Six Cooking Accessories' (title) vs '7 Accessories Included' (bullets)
flags.detail: Both strings appear on the same captured page for B09B7SB46R. Accessory count is a minor spec but it is exactly the kind of detail a reader uses to decide, and it is the kind of error that makes a site look scraped.
flags.action: Confirm on the manufacturer's own page; if still ambiguous, render 'per listing: 6 or 7 (title vs bullets)' instead of choosing silently.

flags.action: Decide the primary audience (Q-10). If NL/EU readers matter, check per-marketplace Associates enrolment before writing more content.

flags.detail: The site carries the required Associates sentence above the fold and in the footer, and a link-level Sponsored label, which is what the cited sources require. It has NOT been reviewed against EU/Dutch consumer-information or e-commerce rules, has no imprint, no entity name and no contact route, and this session makes no claim that it is legally compliant — only that it matches the two published texts in sources.json.
flags.action: Owner + qualified adviser: confirm imprint/identity requirements for a commercial site targeting NL/EU readers, then add entity + contact to the footer.

flags.title: Product identities rest on Amazon marketing copy, not manufacturer data
flags.detail: Brand/model/capacity/dimension values in data/products.json were transcribed from Amazon listing pages (S09-S13). For an affiliate site that is a reasonable source, but Amazon bullets are seller-written marketing text; two of five already show internal contradictions (FLG-005, FLG-010).
flags.action: For numeric specs that drive a buying decision, prefer the manufacturer spec sheet and record its URL + date per cell.
